ac_text: - [ ] AC-1: **Geolocation on load.** On mount the app requests the browser position (timeout ≤8 s). Success centers the map on the user (≤ zoom 16) and shows the current-position glyph. Denial/timeout/unsupported keeps a usable fallback center, shows a non-blocking notice and a "Use my location" retry; no blocking error or repeated permission prompts.

- [ ] AC-2: **Person glyph.** The current-position/walk marker is a green walking-person, rendered as an inline SVG `L.divIcon` (Bootstrap Icons `person-walking`, MIT) on a high-contrast halo, ~32–36 px, with an accessible label; no external font/CDN request. Start/end are blue/red pin glyphs (blue start, red end), one per role, replaced when the point changes.
brief: Add `frontend/src/lib/map/icons.ts` (Bootstrap Icons `person-walking` MIT inline SVG; blue start/red end pins; accessible labels) and `frontend/src/lib/geo/current.ts` (position state machine), each with a vitest `*.test.ts`.
plan_text: - Decision: **inline Bootstrap Icons SVG** (`person-walking`, MIT) in `frontend/src/lib/map/icons.ts`; no font file, no CDN, no FOUT. Start/end pins are small custom SVG paths (blue/red) with `A`/`B` labels. Keep a license comment in the file.

- `frontend/src/lib/map/icons.ts`: `personIcon()`, `startIcon()`, `endIcon()` returning `L.divIcon` HTML; person = white halo + green walking SVG (Bootstrap Icons path; license comment); pins = blue/red SVG with `A`/`B`; `aria-label` via `title`/`alt`.

- `frontend/src/lib/geo/current.ts`: small state machine (`idle → requesting → granted|denied|unsupported|timeout`), `requestCurrentPosition()`, `watchPosition()`/`stopWatch()` wrappers with injected `navigator.geolocation` for tests.
